headline: A 2019 executive order keeps certain existing federal advisory committees running instead of letting them expire.
what_it_does: This order continues the work of certain advisory committees that give advice to the President and federal agencies. Without action, these committees would expire on a set date. Orders like this are usually issued every two years and extend the committees for another two years. No summary was provided, so the specific committees and terms are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the federal advisory committees named in the order
who_it_affects.how: They can keep serving and meeting because their committees do not expire.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies supported by these committees
who_it_affects.how: They keep receiving advice from these committees and continue providing staff and support to them.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 27, 2019; orders of this type usually extend committees about two years.
